mapper.select:
select cs.id, cs.seal_url, cs.sign_url, cs.company_seal, cs.user_id, cs.create_time, case when cs.seal_url is not null then uc.name when cs.company_seal is not null then e.enterprise_name else u.user_name end as userName from contract_seal cs left join tb_user u on cs.user_id = u.user_id left join user_certification uc on cs.user_id = uc.user_id left join enterprise e on cs.user_id = e.user_id where 1=1
and cs.user_id = #{contractSeal.userId}
AND ( u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{contractSeal.userName}, '%') OR uc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{contractSeal.userName}, '%') OR e.enterprise_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{contractSeal.userName}, '%') )
order by cs.create_time desc
